title: Panini- Feasible Grammar For Robot Designs
abstract: arXiv:2611.23567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Symbolic methods make robot designs interpretable but often overlook continuous geometry; learned methods handle geometry but offer less transparent structure. We introduce a typed production grammar that uses case-role relations, parameter inheritance, and specificity-based rule arbitration to generate both manipulation skills and robot morphologies. A geometric realization map translates grammar composition into transformations in SE(3), behaving as a monoid homomorphism when inheritance is inactive and exhibiting a measurable defect when inheritance is enabled. The grammar provides a compact representation, and its arbitration decisions can be recovered from geometric containment (agreement 0.905 +/- 0.062 across 10 seeds, versus 0.611 +/- 0.090 for a Euclidean control). We also introduce PANINI, a cross-entropy search method over grammar-based morphology representations. Across 30 methods and 24 seeds, PANINI achieves the best mean

translated_title: Panini：面向机器人设计的可行文法
translated_abstract: 符号化方法使机器人设计具有可解释性，但往往忽视连续几何；学习方法能处理几何问题，但结构透明度较低。我们提出了一种类型化产生式文法，利用格角色关系、参数继承和基于特异性的规则仲裁，同时生成操作技能和机器人形态。几何实现映射将文法组合转换为SE(3)中的变换，在继承未激活时表现为幺半群同态，在继承启用时则表现出可测量的缺陷。该文法提供了紧凑的表示，其仲裁决策可以从几何包含关系中恢复（在10个随机种子上一致性为0.905 ± 0.062，而欧几里得对照组为0.611 ± 0.090）。我们还提出了PANINI，一种基于文法形态表示的交叉熵搜索方法。在30种方法和24个随机种子的对比中，PANINI取得了最佳平均（成绩）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种类型化产生式文法，通过将文法组合映射为SE(3)中的几何变换，统一生成机器人操作技能与形态，并据此开发了基于交叉熵搜索的PANINI方法，在机器人形态优化上取得最佳平均性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a typed production grammar with a geometric realization map into SE(3) that jointly generates manipulation skills and robot morphologies, and proposes PANINI, a cross-entropy search method over grammar-based morphology representations that achieves the best mean performance.
